method: Hold check of the routed full chip (final_from_h1r, extracted SPEF) at ss_100C_1v60 with the minimum input delay (external launch delay) of every input changed from the SDC's 2.0 ns; the maximum stays 2.0 ns. The clock insertion delay of the chip is about 4.6 ns at this corner.
reading: All 293 hold violations at the slow corner are on input ports and disappear once the inputs are launched at least 3.1 ns after the clock edge at the chip's clock pin; the SDC's 2.0 ns assumption is what produces them.
